problem: Medication awards were recorded but the patient received no ledger confirmation. Failed reporting lost focus to BODY; history exposed local keys instead of available item labels.

impact.baseline: Verified local38 navigation snapshot, not HEAD-only attribution.
impact.contracts: POST/PUT /medications/items and POST/PATCH /medications/reports add participation and replayed. Existing fields/statuses and request schemas remain unchanged.
impact.data: No schema/migration, historical rewrite, rate, source key, role permission or MIS-write change.
impact.atomicity: Read receipt before commit under existing patient/item locks. Four failure-injection tests prove medication state, award and audit remain uncommitted together.
impact.replay: Create returns original creation receipt; edits return the current revision receipt. Same/no-op responses set replayed true, unknown historical awards stay null.
impact.compatibility: Additive response fields; old clients can ignore them, new UI retains unknown-receipt fallback. External clients outside this repository unverified.
impact.release: Local API restarted after passing server tests; main frontend bytes and both DB connections checked. Worker/PostgreSQL preserved.
impact.recovery: Restore these five runtime files from their bounded baseline and rebuild/restart the local API. No schema or data rollback required; rollback not executed.

backendRed.reason: Missing participation/replayed and failure hooks not invoked.
